};

private:
    Edge e[MAXE];
    int n, m, src, dst, head[MAXN], work[MAXN], d[MAXN];
    
    bool _bfs() {
        static int q[MAXN], le, ri;
        le = ri = 0;
        memset(d, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
        q[ri++] = src;
        d[src] = 0;
        while (le < ri) {
            for (int k = q[le++], i = head[k]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {

                    q[ri++] = e[i].v;
                }
